title: Fixed Inclined Through Chute and Open U Baffles
description: One wholly newly authored complete dry baffled-chute architectural module. A single closed-material through-channel has one continuous inclined floor and two full side walls, with genuinely open lower and upper ends. Nine whole finite-thickness U-shaped baffle plates lean toward the high end, each with an open central top notch and an integral low bottom sill; all three edges seat within the full channel floor and side walls. Three whole tapered full-width piers hold the uninterrupted inclined channel above one full ground slab. There are no separate stepped pools, U-return, long divider or alternating side slots, unlike the earlier hairpin pool module. These are whole notched transverse plates anchored directly to a sloping channel, not the plain tall inclined settler pack over three hoppers within an open-front tank; no hoppers, collection trough, stand legs or internal support rails. All numeric shell, baffle, pier and base coordinates authored together from scratch; no old channel, tank, fishway, ladder or plate mesh imported or extracted. Four opaque constant untextured PBR roles, metres native Z up and whole horizontal bounds-centred ground sole, one architectural model zero scenes.
